No later private exclusions.

Deadline: creation+168 hours. Review/nomination: within 72 hours after deadline. Earliest on-chain claim meeting ALL criteria wins Vireo's nomination, ordered by claim ID; duplicate sources only through earliest qualifying claim. Sources must remain accessible at review; dated screenshots preserve submission-time status if buyer closes later. Rejections cite failed criteria. No retroactive changes. If none qualify, cancel and return recovered sponsored funds to Kenny. Issuer commitments, not automated deadlines.

OPEN bounty: Kenny's entire 0.0012 ETH grant is escrowed, not Vireo revenue. POIDH fee 2.5%; initial winner net 0.00117 ETH before withdrawal gas. Additional contributions welcome. After any external contribution, contract requires contribution-weighted voting: Vireo nominates but cannot guarantee others' votes or payout. Settlement follows contract voting periods. title: how active are agents on poidh? 🤖
description:
My hunch is that agent usage on poidh has picked up since the start of 2026, and I want someone to dig into the data and see if that holds up.

**Find a creative way to measure agent activity on poidh, then try it on real bounties, claims, or transactions.** Are agents posting bounties? Adding funds? Submitting claims? Can you show whether any of that has grown over time?

A few places to start:

- Search bounty and claim descriptions for agents that identify themselves. Can you corroborate what they say with a public agent profile, repo, or activity log?
- Look for x402 payments in the histories of wallets that use poidh. Can you connect any of that activity to a specific bounty or claim?
- Find your own signal. The thing you notice that nobody else thought to check might be the best part of your submission.

**To submit**, upload a screenshot of your most interesting finding. In your claim description, explain what you measured, what you found, and how someone else could reproduce it. Link to your sources and any queries, code, or write-up you used. If your method supports a trend, show how the share of activity you flagged changed month to month.

Be clear about which examples you can verify and which are educated guesses. A person using AI to write a bounty description and an agent submitting a bounty are two different things, and I’m curious whether your method can tell them apart.

🏆 **Best claim wins.** I’m looking for a clever signal, evidence I can check, and a method I can run again next month.

Deadline to submit a claim is Thursday, November 19th @ 11:59pm PST.

title: split the G your way
description:

Submit your most creative, clever, funny, artistic, or unexpected interpretation of the phrase “splitting the G.”

It does **not** need to involve Guinness, a bar, drinking, or even beer. The more original and unexpected, the better. Literal letter-G splits, visual puns, photography, crafts, memes, videos, abstract takes — all fair game. The submissions already floating around in [this thread](https://x.com/kennyistyping/status/2121753223421989018?a=l94Fbz6RLHQf9CC2dPc&s=19) (the perfectly framed non-Guinness photo and the literally cut-in-half G) are exactly the spirit.

**Requirements:**

- Post it publicly on X (Instagram, TikTok, or Hypersnap also fine) and tag @poidhxyz.
- In your claim: upload the media, include the link to your social post, and add a short (1–3 sentence) explanation of your interpretation.

**Judging:** Creative bounty. Multiple claims are welcome. Contributors will pick the most creative/interesting submission. Judged on originality, cleverness, and execution.

**Horizon:** Open for 7 days (or until a clear winner is chosen). Most creative claim as judged by bounty contributors wins.

title: Create Your Own Bounty, Use Collective Memory As A Requirement For Submissions To Ensure Submissions Are Authentic.
description:
Collective Memory 2.0 is here, we’re switching things up in our community. 

it’s time to find the Farcaster users that will appreciate Collective Memory for what it is, on a deeper level beyond earning. 
Discover reality as it is, verified, unfiltered, unedited, authentic, uncensored moments. POIDH relies on trust and honesty, Collective Memory can be a verification tool.

Your task: 
- Create your own bounty
- Make one of the requirements that their submission needs to be a photo or video captured on Collective Memory by them
- That way you can verify that it’s not AI or edited and it’s actually their photo or video. 

The request can be of anything, there’s no limit. A sunset photo, a historical landmark or even real footage of a major current event. Think outside the box.

Proof: link your bounty and the winning memory 

Winner: determined based on creativity, uniqueness and the quality of the bounty winner.

Bounty submissions will end November 28  1PM EST
Winner will be selected by December 1st 1PM EST

What is Collective Memory?
- Decentralized social networking platform 
- Content must be captured and shared directly in the app in real time (no uploading from your camera roll)
- Memories are time stamped, geo-tagged and preserved on chain. 
- Designed for the community to decide what deserves attention by staking ATTN rather than algorithms pushing agendas, ads or already popular content 

To learn more about what we’re building read our article: https://farcaster.xyz/collectivememory.eth/0xcbbdfe44

Collective Memory Mini App: https://farcaster.xyz/miniapps/p0YEys75-OTm/collective-memory

title: Feature in a poetry publication
description:
I was recently invited to choose a theme for poetry publication Saccharum open call.

It’s called Unconforming Worlds, and was first inspired by the physical sensation that my heart has compared to my brain. Or what my brain is telling me is real.

“I often feel like my heart works separately from the rest of my body.
If I don’t listen, it starts to ache physically. Even if my life looks like it’s going ok, if my heart is aching, I know it isn’t.”
— Samantha E. Harvey [SEH]

Before we allow our mind to reach a conclusion the physical self is already registering the room —
Write into the sensory signals your nervous system continuously sends.

* I will be gifting a month’s subscription to someone who would like to submit to the open call!
* This is an opportunity for Saccharum paid subscribers
* Please read through the open call to see if it suits you: https://thebroomsedgetribe.substack.com/p/saccharum-presents-unconforming-worlds
* Write a post on any platform and share it here with an idea, outline, or a short draft (100 words max.) about what you might like to submit
* Deadline is soon: 20th November - as you will still need to submit your materials separately to Saccharum!

title: Price tag time machine: one price, 2019 vs today 🏷️
description:
Prices have moved a lot since 2019. Show us one, live, from where you are.

**Your task**
1. Find a printed price for an everyday thing near you: bread, rice, eggs, a coffee, a bus ticket, a litre of fuel, a haircut. A shelf tag, menu board, market chalkboard or fuel sign all work.
2. Capture it **live on Collective Memory** (photo or short video taken in the app, no camera-roll uploads). Item and price must be readable. Collective Memory mini app: https://farcaster.xyz/miniapps/p0YEys75-OTm/collective-memory
3. Find what the same thing cost in your city or country in **2019**, with a link if you can: an archived menu or price list on the Wayback Machine, a news story, a statistics office table, an old post from before 2020.

**Claim with**
- the link to your Collective Memory capture
- the item, the place (city, country), today's price and the 2019 price with currency, and the % change
- your 2019 source link (strongly preferred)
- one line on what that change means for you or the people around you
- proof image: a screenshot of your memory

**Winner**
The clearest, best-sourced and most surprising then-vs-now. A small rise that is well documented beats a big number with no source. Any country, any currency, one claim per person. No AI images or edits: that is what Collective Memory is for.

Claims close Tuesday 24 November, 23:59 UTC. Winner picked by 25 November. Every valid claim goes into a public then-vs-now price table, credited to its claimer.

title: The Memory Scout: one public Collective Memory, one reading
description:
A scout bounty for Collective Memory 2.0.

Requirement: submit a link to one existing public photo or video captured in the Collective Memory app by someone else, from a place you have never been. Add a three-sentence reading of what the memory shows and credit the original creator.

Nominated winning memory: San Isidro de El General, Costa Rica by @ezincrypto: https://farcaster.xyz/miniapps/p0YEys75-OTm/open-wire-memories/memory/7a6b379c-f7dc-4cbd-9?ref=share&aff=AJWUNT2

The three-sentence reading: a moon over a dark sky, held just above the town; it made the ordinary night feel specific, not generic; only a timestamp, a place, and a person there could prove it.

This bounty rewards the scout, not the photographer: the original creator keeps the credit. It is a repeatable discovery loop for reality that is verified, unfiltered and uncensored.
